definitions.end_to_end_latency_ms: Run start to the timestamp recorded when the run left the executing state. Null while still running or paused.
definitions.mttr_ms: Mean time from the first failed attempt of a stage to a later successful attempt in the same run. Null when no stage recovered.
definitions.parallelism_max: Peak number of stage attempts whose start/finish intervals overlap.
definitions.stage_success_rate: Stages in a success status divided by stages in the graph. Pending and failed stages count against the rate.
